notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
We have a smallish patch that fixes a few things.
+ Fixed some bugs
+ Corrects a few typos and grammatical errors. 
+ Change font and dialog box.

Thank you so much for proofreading [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/paperknights]Ark[/url]. :)
Don't worry. English translation is normal. Ark from USA.

Like always, thank you very much for playing Instinct! ^.^

[spoiler] We read every single review that's left for the game, so thanks to those who have left 'em. :)[/spoiler]
